ci_support_linux_64_channel_sourcesconda:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge,conda-forge/label/python_rc
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.15.* *_cp315
rust_compiler:
- rust
target_platform:
- linux-64
zip_keys:
- - python
  - channel_sources
name: safetensors
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: safetensors
  version: "0.8.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/safetensors-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fabaf3e0f18a6618d9b36560682562157f77c2b71fcffc7b432be2baed9d753d

build:
  skip:
    - target_platform == "linux-ppc64le" and "cp314t" in python
  number: 1
  script:
    # PyPy has weird sysconfigdata name
    - if: build_platform != target_platform and target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
      then: rm -f $PREFIX/lib/pypy$PY_VER/_sysconfigdata.py
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
    - cd safetensors && cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output ../THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools-rust
    - maturin >=1.0,<2.0
    - tomli
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - safetensors
      pip_check: true

about:
  summary: Fast and Safe Tensor serialization
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  homepage: https://github.com/huggingface/safetensors

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - setu4993
    - xhochy
